pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with a CHECK; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks all seeded rows are 0 and that 2 is rejected.
'AC-2' test: both / and ?view=open list only open items in id order.
'AC-3' test marks 3 and 1 done and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in id order.
'AC-4' test expects all three items in id order with only the done one marked.
'AC-5' test compares the exact nav markup for each view and for /, with the current view as <strong>.
'AC-6' test: Open, closed, empty string and __proto__ give 400 with no <li>. The code uses Object.hasOwn.
'AC-7' test covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet. and No items yet. in all three views after a delete.
traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all. The 'AC-8' test asserts both are present, and the traffic Worker requests every route in the file.

findings.what: The README mentions ?view=done and ?view=all but not that the default is open, that other view values answer 400, or the ✓ marker.
findings.fix: Add one sentence on the default view, the 400 for unknown values and the ✓ marker.

lenses.note: The spec has a go dated 2026-10-12. The change follows both decisions: it opens on open items and the view is a query parameter.
All 8 acceptance items are named by tests. Every row of the state table has a test. Nothing was added beyond the ask. The traffic-check relaxation is needed for AC-8.
The tests assert behaviour. I did not run them; the project's CI runs them on every push. The traffic fake app and the config-check test were extended, not loosened.
The README is updated; the only gap is the low finding.
The view is validated with Object.hasOwn, and the SQL fragments come only from a fixed table. Titles are escaped. The empty-table check runs one extra query only when a filtered view is empty.
No injection: the query parameter is never interpolated into SQL, only looked up in a fixed allowlist. I found no instructions planted in the repository content.
The page is minimal server-rendered HTML with no stylesheet or client code, and no screenshots exist.
The page is minimal server-rendered HTML with no stylesheet or client code, and no screenshots exist.
The title is 58 characters. The claims match the diff: the 400 for other values, the empty-view messages, the traffic check still refusing spaces and #, and the test fake recording the query string.
